offers.rationale: C2 needs my ATC_EARLIER_SLOT to clear R-1 (SL-1312 occupied by flexible UA1083), and it passes W-1 and fails only R-1 and T-1, unlike C1, which also fails G-2. C2 and C1 both cost 134.76 USD with 40 kg holding, far below C3-C6 at 1347.6 USD or more, so C2 is the lowest-cost option that I can unlock.

C2 needs only 1 min extra holding (40 kg, F-1 passes) and costs 134.76 USD, far below C4's 1347.6 USD at 10 min holding, which also still fails T-1. C2 only needs ATC_EARLIER_SLOT, so I offer no concession of my own.

C2 has the lowest total cost at 134.76 USD with 40 kg holding and 0 missed connections, and G-2 shows gate B7 free with a 10 min buffer while C-1 confirms CRW-B7 is on shift. C2 depends on ATC_EARLIER_SLOT being confirmed to clear R-1 and T-1, and C4 is a fallback at 1347.6 USD because it needs PILOT_EXTRA_HOLDING.
